# Quick analysis: 2040 results with fixed offshore wind cost (No DAC baselines)

*Generated by Claude, 2026-11-13. Data: `results_fixedOffshoreWTCost/results/2040_1`. Compared with the
previous runs in `DAC-Offshore-MaianJan/results/2040_1` (report: `analysis_2040.md` in
`dac_offshore/claude_quick_analysis`).*

So far the folder only has the three **No DAC baseline** runs (cy 1995, 2008, 2009), so this report
covers costs and the system design behind them. The capture costs can't be updated until the
target runs are in (section 5).

## 1. What changed in the code

| Fix | Commit | Visible in the new runs |
|---|---|---|
| Offshore substation removed from `Offshore_Wind` | `09c9ac69` | Yes, `para_unitCAPEX` = **1.856 M EUR/MW** at all 42 offshore nodes (was 3.141) |
| Baseline also minimises costs + storage/flow penalties (`_optimize_cost_penalized`) | `c347ae62` | Yes, `ub − total_npv` = 15–17 M EUR (was 0) |
| Flow penalty on total arc flow (was always 0) | `c347ae62` | Yes, circulating flows are gone (section 4) |

Both penalties are 0.01 EUR per MWh (smallest objective coefficient in the solver log: 1e-2). That's
100× lower than the 1 EUR mentioned in the status box of the previous report, so open question 11 there
is resolved. All three runs are `optimal` with gap 0.

## 2. Total costs

| bn EUR/yr | cy 1995 old | cy 1995 new | cy 2008 old | cy 2008 new | cy 2009 old | cy 2009 new |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Total (`total_npv`)** | **90.72** | **86.79** | **69.82** | **69.82** | **69.99** | **68.98** |
| Change | | −3.94 (−4.3 %) | | +0.00 | | −1.02 (−1.5 %) |
| Technology CAPEX | 31.96 | 29.39 | 24.70 | 24.70 | 23.68 | 21.37 |
| Technology OPEX | 8.00 | 7.91 | 6.25 | 6.25 | 6.52 | 6.12 |
| Network CAPEX | 17.05 | 16.37 | 11.35 | 11.35 | 8.40 | 9.73 |
| Network OPEX | 13.07 | 12.80 | 10.85 | 10.85 | 9.64 | 10.12 |
| Imports | 13.84 | 13.63 | 11.18 | 11.18 | 14.59 | 14.51 |
| Carbon cost (189 EUR/t) | 6.80 | 6.69 | 5.49 | 5.49 | 7.17 | 7.13 |
| Penalties (objective only, M EUR) | 0 | 17.2 | 0 | 15.3 | 0 | 16.0 |
| Positive emissions (Mt/yr) | 35.98 | 35.41 | 29.06 | 29.06 | 37.91 | 37.71 |

- **cy 1995 and 2009 get cheaper; cy 2008 doesn't change.** The 2008 cost changes by 8 k EUR, and its
  design is identical to within rounding.
- **The climate-year gap shrinks.** cy 1995 was 30 % more expensive than 2008/2009 and is now 24–26 %
  more expensive. 2009 is now cheaper than 2008 (68.98 vs. 69.82 bn EUR).
- **Emissions drop a little** (−0.56 Mt in 1995, −0.21 Mt in 2009), because the extra offshore wind
  replaces some gas generation. Imports and carbon cost go down by 0.1–0.3 bn EUR.
- The penalties are 0.02 % of total costs and aren't in `total_npv`, so they don't affect the cost
  numbers directly.

## 3. Where the change comes from

![Cost change by component](figures/fig1_baseline_cost_change.png)

*Figure 1: Change in annualised cost (CAPEX + fixed and variable OPEX) by component, new − old.
Network costs are halved, because every arc is stored in both directions in the h5 file.*

| bn EUR/yr, new − old | cy 1995 | cy 2008 | cy 2009 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Offshore wind | −0.84 | 0.00 | +2.02 |
| Onshore wind | −3.30 | 0.00 | −3.37 |
| PV | +0.86 | 0.00 | −0.76 |
| Batteries | +0.50 | 0.00 | −0.62 |
| Other technologies | +0.11 | 0.00 | +0.03 |
| Electricity networks | −0.95 | 0.00 | +1.82 |
| Imports + carbon cost | −0.32 | 0.00 | −0.12 |
| **Total** | **−3.94** | **0.00** | **−1.02** |

**Installed capacity (new build, GW):**

| | cy 1995 old → new | cy 2008 old → new | cy 2009 old → new |
|---|---|---|---|
| Offshore wind | 23.5 → **35.3** | 0 → 0 | 1.6 → **11.6** |
| Onshore wind | 75.0 → 57.0 | 82.7 → 82.7 | 78.0 → 59.3 |
| PV | 81.5 → 95.7 | 75.4 → 75.4 | 94.3 → 81.8 |
| New DC offshore links | 122.9 → 125.0 | 69.5 → 69.5 | 60.3 → 75.0 |
| New AC onshore links | 36.4 → 38.9 | 43.1 → 43.1 | 74.6 → 93.5 |

**cy 1995: more offshore wind for less money.** Offshore wind grows by 11.8 GW: NO_B 0.6 → 4.4 GW,
DK_C 0 → 5.1, UK_K 0 → 1.7, NL_F 0 → 0.6, NO_A 22.9 → 23.5. Its cost still goes down by 0.84 bn EUR,
because the unit CAPEX drops by 41 %. It replaces 18 GW of onshore wind (−3.3 bn EUR). PV and batteries
grow a little. Network costs go down although slightly more capacity is built. The DC links are
rearranged around the new farms (e.g. DK1–DK_C 2.8 GW new, NO1–UK_D 4.2 → 1.2 GW), and the offshore DC
network costs 1.0 bn EUR less.

**cy 2009: offshore wind and the links to shore replace onshore wind and PV.** 10 GW of new offshore
wind at UK_I (3.3), UK_J (3.4) and UK_K (4.8), each connected to UK3 by a new DC link (3.0, 2.6 and 3.9 GW).
UK_K is now at its offshore potential. Offshore wind (+2.0) and networks (+1.8) cost 3.8 bn EUR more.
That's more than paid for by 19 GW less onshore wind, 12 GW less PV and fewer batteries (−4.8 bn EUR).

**cy 2008: offshore wind is still not built.** Even at 1.86 M EUR/MW, no offshore wind is built in 2008.
The obvious difference between the climate years is onshore wind: its mean capacity factor is 0.378 in
2008, vs. 0.325 in 1995 and 0.349 in 2009. Offshore wind is about the same in all three years
(0.556–0.576). So in 2008 onshore wind stays cheaper than offshore wind plus the link to shore. Only a few
onshore nodes are at their potential, so this is a cost choice, not a potential limit.

## 4. Circulating flows are gone

| | cy 1995 | cy 2008 | cy 2009 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Circulating electricity flow, old (TWh/yr) | 22.6 | 50.7 | 50.7 |
| Circulating electricity flow, new (MWh/yr) | 134 | 574 | 229 |
| Total electricity arc flow, old → new (TWh/yr) | 1,458 → 1,379 | 1,374 → 1,229 | 1,415 → 1,316 |

The fixed flow penalty removes the simultaneous flow in both directions (6.5 B in the previous report)
completely. Total arc flow drops by 5–11 %, partly because the circulation is gone and partly because
the penalty also discourages unnecessary transit. Network flows from the new runs can be plotted
without netting.

## 5. What this means for the DAC runs

- **The previous capture costs are out of date.** They are `total_npv` of the target run minus that of the
  baseline. The baselines dropped by 3.9 bn EUR (1995) and 1.0 bn EUR (2009), which is
  70–2,000 EUR/t depending on the target (2009 at 15 Mt to 1995 at 2 Mt). So the old target runs and the new baselines **must not be combined**. All target runs
  have to be repeated with the new code.
- **cy 2008 should change little,** because its baseline didn't change at all. It's a useful check once the
  new target runs are in: if offshore DAC still doesn't use offshore wind in 2008, that's consistent.
- **Offshore DAC next to offshore wind is now more plausible in 1995 and 2009.** Offshore wind at the farm
  is now cheaper than onshore wind (48 vs. 62 EUR/MWh LCOE, section 7 of the previous report), and the
  baselines now build it at NO_A/NO_B, DK_C and UK_I–K. Several of these nodes are also offshore DAC
  sites. Before the fix, offshore DAC was powered by onshore wind and PV through the grid.
- **The DAC "substitution" effect should get smaller.** Previously, DAC runs built onshore wind and
  removed some of the baseline's offshore wind (point 2 in 5.5 of the previous report). With offshore wind
  now competitive, I'd expect less of this, and so fewer large negative network and offshore wind entries in
  the capture cost breakdown.

## 6. Flags

1. **`Summary.xlsx` still contains the old runs.** Each `<cy>/No_DAC/Summary.xlsx` in the new folder has
   two rows: the old run (time stamp `20261111…`) and the new one (`20261113…`). The old result
   folders aren't in this folder. `concat_summaries.py` reads both rows, so the baseline appears twice per
   climate year. Once target runs are added, the No-DAC cost lookup (`set_index("climate_year")`) fails or
   picks the wrong baseline. Either drop the old rows from the summaries or filter by time stamp in
   `concat_summaries.py`.
2. **`extract_run_metrics.py` runs on import.** It has no `if __name__ == "__main__"` guard. Importing a
   function from it re-reads every run in `Summary_2040_processed.csv` and overwrites `data/*.csv`. (This
   happened while making this report. The 75-run files from the old results were regenerated and are
   unchanged.)
